UPPSC Lecturer 2023 Exam City Details – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the admit card for selection to the posts of Scientific Officer, Dental Surgeon, Lecturer, Medical Officer, Reader under the Advt No. D-3/E-1/2023. The vacancy came in the year 2023 and it took almost one year eleven month to conduct the written examination for the prescribed posts. UPPSC is going to conduct a written examination on 02-06 November 2026 for the posts of 395 UPPSC Lecturer in various locations of Uttar Pradesh. Candidates who have submitted the online application form can check their UPPSC Lecturer Admit Card 2026 from the direct link provided below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 June 2023
  • Last Date : 14 July 2023
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 14 July 2023
  • Last Date Receipt Hard Copy : 28 July 2023
  • Dental Surgeon Exam Date : 01 October 2023
  • Homoeopathic Medical Officer Exam Date : 15 September 2024
  • Homoeopathic Residential Medical Officer Exam Date : 18 September 2024
  • Unani Medical Officer Exam Date : 06 October 2024
  • Scientific Officer Exam Date : 18 May 2025
  • Admit Card : 08 May 2025
  • Lecturer Exam Date : 02 to 06 November 2026
  • Lecturer Admit Card : 24 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 105/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 65/-
  • PH : Rs. 25/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

What is UPPSC Lecturer 2023 Exam City Details?

UPPSC Lecturer 2023 Exam City Details is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.
